note: The quantifier order (family before the sequence p, then q and one hierarchy) and the content (regularity, Properties = convergence of S^mix ∘ pi_quo plus Q2-Q6) are the same. Simple compact matrix gauge groups with nonabelian simple real Lie algebra correspond to GaugeGroup with IsSimple.

snippet.text:
def IsSimple (gauge : GaugeGroup) : Prop :=
  (∃ X ∈ gauge.lieAlgebra, ∃ Y ∈ gauge.lieAlgebra,
    X * Y - Y * X ≠ 0) ∧
  ∀ ideal : Submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin (gauge.n + 1)) (Fin (gauge.n + 1)) ℂ),
    ideal ≤ gauge.lieAlgebra →
    (∀ X ∈ gauge.lieAlgebra, ∀ Y ∈ ideal, X * Y - Y * X ∈ ideal) →
    ideal = ⊥ ∨ ideal = gauge.lieAlgebra
